Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereConvertHaldaneBasis`

FQHESphereConvertHaldaneBasis, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereConvertHaldaneBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --input-file : input state file name

    -z, --total-lz : twice the total momentum projection for the system (override autodetection from input file name if greater or equal to zero) (default value = -1)
    -r, --reverse : convert a state from the n-body basis to the Haldane basis
    -f, --fermion : use fermionic statistic (override autodetection from input file name)
    -b, --boson : use bosonic statistics (override autodetection from input file name)
    --rational : use rational numbers instead of double precision floating point numbers
    --target-haldane : target space is also a Haldane squeezed basis instead of the full n-body basis
    --target-referencefile : definition of the target reference state
    --target-full : target space is full Hilbert space (all Lz sectors)
    --target-ptruncated : target space is also a p-truncated basis instead of the full n-body basis
    --target-ptruncation : p-truncation for the target basis (if --target-ptruncated is used) (default value = 0)
    --huge-basis : use huge Hilbert space support (only available when both the source and target spaces are squeezed basis)
    --memory : maximum memory (in MBytes) that can allocated for precalculations when using huge mode (default value = 100)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (removing any occurence of haldane_)

precalculation options:
    --save-hilbert : save Hilbert space description in the indicated file and exit (only available for the non-symmetric Haldane basis)
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file
    --target-loadhilbert : load the target Hilbert space description from the indicated file
